documentation_excerpts.text: Alpaca US-equity data and execution clients for NautilusTrader 1.229.0. Python package: `kumo_nautilus_alpaca`. Python 3.13 is required.

- Historical raw OHLCV bars, paginated REST reads, and live bars/trades/quotes. - Equity definitions with canonical `SYMBOL.MIC` instrument IDs. - Order submission, native brackets, cancellation, modification, and reconciliation. - Per-execution fill reports with stable venue activity IDs. Fills arrive through reconciliation; an account trade-updates WebSocket is not implemented. - Broker account, equity curve, position drift, and skipped-order bus messages.

This extraction has offline tests. It has not completed an independent paper-account smoke test as a standalone package. Paper endpoints are the default; a host can explicitly configure other endpoints. The package never originates strategy orders.
